agent.finish_summary: Fixed sqlparse regression: IdentifierList.get_identifiers() in sqlparse/sql.py had an inverted condition causing it to yield whitespace/comma tokens instead of actual identifiers. This broke aligned-indent formatting (reindent_aligned=True), which relies on get_identifiers() in _process_identifierlist to align SELECT column lists. Changed the condition from 'if (token.is_whitespace or token.match(T.Punctuation, ','))' to 'if not (...)' so it correctly skips whitespace/punctuation and yields identifiers, matching the function's docstring. Verified with manual test that sqlparse.format(sql, reindent_aligned=True) now produces correctly aligned output.
